title: Kanmani Anbudan
description: Rajasekar wakes from his coma and brings joy to his family by identifying them. Vennila grows anxious about being exposed but feels relieved when he fails to recognise her.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: Rishi's men kidnap Ilamathi, leaving Paraman frantic as he searches everywhere for her. Later, Rishi confronts Ilamathi and threatens to drop her from the mountain.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: Karna's shocking confession brings the wedding to a halt, while Prabhakaran and Vetri expose his crime with evidence. Swetha furiously confronts him over her sister's murder.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Palanivel convinces Saravanan to attend the bangle ceremony for his baby's sake. Later, Bhagyam breaks down in tears when Muthusudar sends photos of Thangamayil.

title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Chandayatha's prayers turn Pandian spiritual, shocking Nila. When Sembaruthi visits the couple, Nadesan rides her home, and Pandian reveals that she is Nadesan's ex-girlfriend.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Vijaya plans to send Nachiyar to an old-age home with Parvathy's help. Elsewhere, Ragu attracts Muthu's customers with tempting offers, putting his business at risk.

title: Super Singer Junior
description: The Race to Finale begins with the top 10 contestants competing for the Golden Buzzer and belt. As the competition heats up, tune in to see who secures the ticket to the finale!

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
description: Madhu grows increasingly fond of Arjun after he returns the pearl chain she lost during the struggle. Meanwhile, Karthik angrily confronts Sethupathi for troubling Kasthuri.
